containers.name: fair-value
containers.notes: Next.js release copied from the node's active slot and run as node server.js, uid 1001 (deploy). Database credentials stay in /etc/fair-value/<slot>.env and are not baked in.

containers.name: fair-value-mcp
containers.notes: uvicorn serving mcp_server.asgi:app on 8011, reached by the /mcp* and /v1/* split rule. The image recreates /usr/bin/python3.12 because the copied venv's console scripts point at it and python:3.12-slim keeps python under /usr/local/bin; without that link every entrypoint fails with a misleading 'not found'. TCP health: GET /mcp answers 405 by design.
